title: ACVIM consensus statement guidelines for the classification, diagnosis, and management of cardiomyopathies in cats.
recommendation_basis: 指南原文推荐强度见 guideline_strengths_verbatim
one_line_conclusion_zh: ACVIM 2020 猫心肌病指南：有 CHF 史且左房中重度扩大的猫推荐氯吡格雷 18.75 mg/猫 q24h 预防血栓（LOE low）。
rob_judgement: 见逐项判断（该工具不设总体判断）
guideline_recommendation: "Prophylactic antithrombotic treatment with clopidogrel (18.75 mg/cat PO q24h, with food) is recommended in any cat with a history of CHF and moderate to severe LA enlargement (LOE low)"；推荐强度措辞：is recommended / should be considered / may be considered / is not recommended；LOE：low / medium / high；全文标签计数（我方统计）：low 52、medium 17、high 16

phase_md: Phase 0 分段：全文 Methods/Results/Discussion 速读。Phase 1 主题：ACVIM 共识（猫心肌病）；改良 Delphi，共识 = 9 人中 ≥6 人同意；PubMed 检索 475 篇参考。Phase 2 论点—论据：ACVIM 2020 猫心肌病指南：有 CHF 史且左房中重度扩大的猫推荐氯吡格雷 18.75 mg/猫 q24h 预防血栓（LOE low）。。Phase 3 自检：结论受 AGREE II 所列偏倚限制；单人速读，未双人复核。
